notes:
Deleting pistons no longer leaves a tablet counting from a number that is gone.

**Place pistons back and forth on both tablets, delete them, and the next one starts from what is actually on the page** — not from the highest number that tablet happens to remember placing.

Each tablet keeps a private note of the last piston you placed on it, so the next one carries on from there. That note is now only believed while the piston it names still exists. Delete that piston — on either tablet — and the note stops counting, and the numbering falls back to one past the highest still on the page. Delete all of them and you start again at 1.

This replaces the separate delete handling added in 2.04, which could only see pistons deleted on its own tablet. Everything from the last few updates still holds: place 12 and get 13, delete 13 and get 13 back, renumber 320 down to 250 and get 251, and a number the other tablet has taken is skipped.
